title: dactylorhiza urvilleana subsp. bithynica
intro: Dactylorhiza urvilleana subsp. bithynica, commonly known as the Bithynian marsh orchid, is a subspecies of orchid native to Europe and Asia. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help to soothe digestive issues and promote wound healing. The therapeutic actions of Dactylorhiza urvilleana subsp. bithynica are attributed to its ability to stimulate the cardiovascular system, improve blood circulation, and exhibit antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include iridoids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
